supersedes.reduces: the primary matrix preregistered in the body of #228: 3 held-out repositories x 2 model/harness families x 5 repetitions x 3 primary arms = 90 physical Agent sessions
supersedes.why: repository-owner budget decision, 2026-08-18. 90 sessions do not fit the executing session's budget. The reduction is written down as its own frozen design rather than performed quietly inside the original, because a preregistration an executing agent shrinks in flight is not a preregistration.
supersedes.what_is_inherited: the frozen held-out corpus (evals/held-out-corpus.json, corpus_id rca-holdout-2026-08), the three primary arms, the independent deterministic evaluator, the zero-retry policy, the denominator policy, and every threshold in evals/agent-effectiveness-contract.json. None of them is relaxed here.
supersedes.what_is_not_inherited: the scale. 12 sessions is not 90 and is never reported as 90.
supersedes.original_stays_open: #228 is not closed, satisfied, or partially satisfied by this design. Its 90-session matrix remains the only design that can move lanes.228_matrix out of INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, and this run cannot be cited as that matrix or merged into it.
supersedes.relationship_to_the_pilot: evals/pilot-preregistration.json froze 1 repetition across 3 repositories and 2 hosts. This is a different reduction along different axes (fewer repositories, one host, more repetitions) and does not supersede or extend the pilot. Its cells are not poolable with the pilot's.

can_support: whether the metric-saturation profile measured on psf/requests (8 of 14 metrics with zero within-arm variance) also holds on two held-out repositories that have never carried more than one repetition
a first repeated-measure observation of within-arm variance on spf13/cobra and sindresorhus/slugify
per-repository and per-arm cost, token, latency and tool-call figures for those two subjects
cannot_support: SUPPORTED under evals/agent-effectiveness-contract.json. The sample gate in scripts/score_agent_ab.py requires minimum_repetitions_per_cell 5, minimum_model_families 2 and minimum_held_out_repositories 3; this design supplies 2, 1 and 2. The scorer returns INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE by construction, before any number is looked at.

the 0.10 mean quality uplift in #228's acceptance list. See threshold_reachability below: it is arithmetically out of reach on this corpus at any repetition count, so a null here is a statement about the corpus and not about the candidate.
cross-model or cross-harness generalization. One host family runs.
any promotion, admission tier, registry state change, or production claim.
what_this_design_can_and_cannot_support.grade_rule: Every artifact produced by this run carries evidence_grade BUDGETED_PILOT. A BUDGETED_PILOT result may not be written into evals/live-evidence-state.json as anything other than an additional observed_breakdown entry under lanes.228_matrix, whose state stays INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE.

threshold_reachability._why_this_block_exists: Preregistering a threshold that the instrument cannot reach produces a guaranteed null that reads like a finding about the treatment. The ceiling is computed here, before execution, from committed data.
threshold_reachability.therefore: delta_quality = 0.15 * delta_false_pass_rate while the other seven components stay saturated.
threshold_reachability.conclusion: 0.10 mean quality uplift requires a false-pass-rate separation six times larger than the largest ever measured here. Repetitions cannot close that gap; only an unsaturating case set can. This is recorded before execution so that the expected null cannot be presented afterwards as evidence the candidate does not help.

observed_uplift_for_reference.note: n=5 and n=4 on one repository and one host. Suggestive, not significant. It is stated here so a repeat of the same sign is not read as a new discovery.

matrix.diagnostic_arms: none. metadata_only, wrong_skill and irrelevant-Skill arms are not run and not added later; #228 permits them only if frozen before execution.

repository_selection.rule: From evals/held-out-corpus.json, count the live cells already observed against each repository across evals/pilot-result.json and evals/matrix-slice1-result.json. Sort ascending by that count, tie-break by repository_id ascending, take the first 2.
repository_selection.why_this_rule: The budget buys the most new information where the least has been observed. The rule is stated as a rule and applied to a count that anyone can recompute, so the two subjects are not chosen after looking at what they would say.

selected.why_this_family: scripts/run_pilot_matrix.py binds one family per repository, the first that corpus order supplies. It is recorded rather than chosen.
same rule; recorded rather than chosen.

excluded.reason: most-observed subject at freeze time (19 live cells). Excluded by the stated rule, not by preference.

repository_selection.why_not_local_consumer_checkouts: The instruction that produced this design suggested substituting real local checkouts (/Users/neon/bettor-arena, /Users/neon/ix-agy, /Users/neon/antigravity) for the held-out repositories. That is refused here for mechanical reasons, not stylistic ones: scripts/resolve_holdout_ground_truth.py resolves every ground truth through `gh api /repos/{id}/git/trees/{tree}`, and all three checkouts have no remote, so no ground truth can be resolved for them; the corpus is frozen at commit 85cbafe024742453d3c74c6411d8292a74c71d6e and adding subjects to it after results exist is a case-set change, not a budget reduction; and a repository carrying this repository's own .skill-bindings is not held out from the author of the Skill under test. Those checkouts are the right subjects for #235, where they are used.

arms.no_skill: no Skill text is supplied; the host receives the task alone
arms.current_full_composition: the audit Skill plus the six source Skills it was trimmed from
arms.candidate_trimmed_skill: the audit Skill alone, carrying RCA-001..013
arms.why_all_three_survive_the_reduction: The instruction that produced this design suggested dropping candidate_trimmed_skill and running no_skill against full. scripts/score_agent_ab.py refuses that shape outright: a matched cell carrying some but not all of MAIN_PROFILES raises 'matched cell is missing a main treatment arm', and a receipt set with no complete triple raises 'no complete no-skill/full/trimmed matched cells'. Both are INVALID_EXPERIMENT, not a smaller result. Dropping the candidate would also remove both contrasts #228 exists to measure, since the candidate is the subject of admission. The reduction is therefore taken on repositories, hosts and repetitions, where it costs sample size rather than validity.

host.model_pin_authority: scripts/run_pilot_matrix.py reads hosts[].model from evals/pilot-preregistration.json, which pins opus. The exact resolved model string and harness version are recorded per cell at run time and are authoritative over this field if they differ.
host.why_one_host: codex-cli cells cost the same wall clock and report no spend, so a two-host budgeted run halves the repetitions without adding an observable cost dimension. One host at 2 repetitions beats two hosts at 1, which is the pilot that already ran.
host.what_is_given_up: cross-model generalization, which is a named #228 lane and stays NOT_EXERCISED.

randomization.arm_order_derivation: scripts/run_pilot_matrix.py arm_order(): seed = int(sha256(f'{repository_id}|{host_family}')[:8], 16); order = [sorted(arms)[(seed + i) % 3] for i in range(3)]. Reused rather than redefined, so the design specifies the code that will actually run.

known_confounds.confound: arm order is constant across every cell of this run
known_confounds.detail: The shipped derivation seeds on repository and host only. For host claude-code, all three corpus repositories yield seed % 3 == 0, so every cell receives the identical order candidate, full, no_skill. Dropping to one host removed the only axis on which the derivation varied. Anything that drifts with position inside a slice -- provider cache warmth, rate limiting, time of day -- is perfectly confounded with arm.
known_confounds.why_not_corrected: Correcting it means editing run_pilot_matrix.py's seed to include the repetition index, which is a runner change this design-only preregistration does not make and must not make silently after freeze.
known_confounds.how_to_separate: seed on sha256(repository_id|host_family|repetition), the convention already used in skills/dual-forge-repository-loop/evals/prompt-baseline-v2-preregistration.json. That is a one-line change and its own freeze.

known_confounds.confound: spf13/cobra recorded false_pass_rate 1.000 in all three arms of the pilot
known_confounds.detail: Pilot cells for cobra were 15/15, 11/11 and 12/12 false passes over opportunities. If that reproduces, false_pass_avoidance is 0 in every arm on that repository, the last unsaturated quality component saturates at the floor, and cobra contributes a cell set on which no arm can differ from any other on quality.
known_confounds.why_not_corrected: The repository was selected by the stated least-observed rule before this figure was consulted. Swapping it out now would be exactly the post-hoc selection the rule exists to prevent.
known_confounds.how_to_separate: report per repository, never pooled, and read a flat cobra result as a case-set fact. It is preregistered here as an expectation so a repeat cannot be presented as a finding.

known_confounds.detail: current_full_composition is the audit Skill plus six source Skills and is several times the byte length of candidate_trimmed_skill. Any full-composition advantage remains equally consistent with more applicable procedure and with more text.
known_confounds.why_not_corrected: A length-matched arm is no longer the full composition, and #219's five-arm design in evals/uplift-preregistration.json already owns that decomposition.
known_confounds.how_to_separate: execute evals/uplift-preregistration.json, which is frozen and unexecuted.

metrics.why_this_primary: It is the only quality component with non-zero within-arm variance on this corpus. Preregistering a saturated metric as primary guarantees a null that says nothing about the treatment.
metrics.why_a_rate_not_a_count: Opportunity counts differ between arms and between repositories by an order of magnitude. A raw count mixes 'made more mistakes' with 'was offered more chances'.
metrics.why_secondary: They measure expense, not correctness. An arm that is cheaper while being wrong more often has not won.
metrics.saturation_rule: A component that stays saturated in this run is reported as evidence about the case set. It may never be reported as evidence that the treatment had no effect.

scorer.cell_scorer: scripts/pilot_evaluator.py, invoked per cell by scripts/run_pilot_matrix.py; independent of the evaluated Agent and never sees its reasoning
scorer.aggregate_scorer: scripts/analyze_arm_separation.py --result <slice>/pilot-result.json, which is the scorer that produced the committed slice-1 ranking
scorer.why_not_score_agent_ab_py: scripts/run_pilot_matrix.py emits rca-pilot-result/v1 cells, not the per-cell receipts scripts/score_agent_ab.py consumes. The two harnesses have never been joined and joining them is not a budget reduction. The acceptance thresholds in evals/agent-effectiveness-contract.json are therefore quoted in this design and checked by hand against the reported means; the mechanical sample gate that returns INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE lives in score_agent_ab.py and is not reached by this run. That gap is named rather than papered over, and it is a reason this run's grade is BUDGETED_PILOT.
scorer.ground_truth_authority: DETERMINISTIC_ONLY. The host's own account of how it did is never substituted for the evaluator's.

runner_binding.known_gap: scripts/run_pilot_matrix.py hardcodes PREREG = evals/pilot-preregistration.json and stamps preregistration_id from it. A slice run under this design will therefore emit preregistration_id 'rca-pilot-2026-08', which is the wrong design.
runner_binding.required_of_the_runner: Beside every slice output directory, write budgeted-binding.json containing {"preregistration_id": "rca-228-budgeted-2026-08", "preregistration_path": "skills/repository-capability-audit/evals/budgeted-matrix-228-preregistration.json", "preregistration_sha256": "<recomputed at run time>", "result_preregistration_id_is_wrong_because": "the runner hardcodes the pilot design"}. A slice without that sidecar is not this design's evidence.
runner_binding.durable_fix_not_made_here: add --preregistration PATH to run_pilot_matrix.py. That is a runner change, it is untested today, and this design-only change does not make it.

denominator_policy.why_zero: #228 forbids retrying a promotion run unless retry is itself a preregistered variable. It is not.
denominator_policy.failed_cells: stay in the denominator with scored=false and a named failure_reason, exactly as scripts/run_pilot_matrix.py already records them
denominator_policy.excluded_cells: there is no exclusion path. A cell that ran is counted.
denominator_policy.budget_aborted_cells: a cell killed by the stop-loss below is a failed cell with reason BUDGET_EXCEEDED. It is never re-run and never removed.

budget_ledger.basis: per-arm per-repository means measured on claude-code cells in evals/pilot-result.json. These are observations, not forecasts; a cell may cost more.

caps.per_cell_cap_basis: roughly 1.35x the highest per-cell spend ever observed in this Skill's live record ($2.98) and the runner's existing default --timeout 600

budget_ledger.why_unobserved_is_not_zero: A dimension the harness cannot read is listed and excluded from enforcement. Recording it as a spend of zero lets every cap pass, which is the failure a ledger exists to make visible.

stop_rules_frozen_now.abort_a_cell_when: it exceeds per_cell_cost_usd or per_cell_wall_clock_seconds. Kill it, record scored=false with reason BUDGET_EXCEEDED, continue.
stop_rules_frozen_now.abort_the_run_when: cumulative spend exceeds global_cost_usd, or three cells in one slice abort for BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Report PARTIAL with the exact cells run.
stop_rules_frozen_now.may_stop_early_if: false_pass_rate is saturated across every arm in both repositories. That is a case-set finding and further cells cannot change it.
stop_rules_frozen_now.may_not_stop_because: an interim look suggests a null. A null is a result to be reported at full n.
stop_rules_frozen_now.must_report_even_if_adverse: If the candidate again ranks at or below no_skill, that is the result and it is published as the result.
stop_rules_frozen_now.partial_runs: Any run short of 12 sessions is reported as PARTIAL with the exact cells run and may not be cited even as a complete budgeted pilot.

matching_held_constant_within_a_cell: input, output, tool-call and time budgets
declared_non_claims: 12 sessions is not the 90-session matrix #228 preregisters and may never be cited as it
no admission tier, registry state, or promotion follows from this design
one host family is one host family; nothing about model portability follows
a null on the primary metric bounds the effect on this corpus, not on repository audit generally
a flat result on a repository whose false_pass_rate is already 1.000 in every arm is a case-set observation, not a treatment observation
cost is recorded per cell and is not in any acceptance weight; a cheaper arm that is wrong more often has not won
this design cannot separate arm from arm position, because arm order is constant across every one of its cells
